title: Chapter 570 - 570 First Place In The Kill; Reward!
content:
Chapter 570 - 570 First Place In The Kill; Reward!

Chapter 570 - 570 First Place in the Kill; Reward!

570 First Place in the Kill; Reward!

Hendry, who had a machine gun on his body and several grenades around his waist, kept moving forward in the wilderness.

His face was filled with a relaxed expression. He did not panic at all.

He would even introduce the place to the audience watching like a tour guide.

“Hello, everyone in front of the screen! This is the Otherworld. There’s a faint licorice smell in the air, which is very sweet.

“Walking here, I can’t help but think of the spring outing not long ago. My girlfriend and I had a great time in the wilderness.”

At this point, he seemed to think of his girlfriend, and his face was filled with longing.

Then, he sighed and said, “It’s a pity that my girlfriend didn’t become a hero. Otherwise, I think this trip to the Otherworld would’ve been even more perfect!”

He knew that he was being broadcasted live.

Firstly, this could relieve his boredom.

Secondly, this was also a good opportunity to attract people.

Popularity was money!

After the trip to the Otherworld ended, he might even be able to earn a lot of money from his popularity.

While Hendry was talking to himself…

Whoosh!

The ground in front of them suddenly collapsed.

In the next moment…

A giant black scorpion that was even taller than him suddenly jumped out of the ground.

Drops of crystal clear liquid flowed out of the scorpion’s black mouth.

Seeing this…

Hendry was stunned.

He had never seen such a huge black scorpion before.

At this moment, the scorpion let out an ear-piercing cry.

Then, the scorpion raised its malevolent steel pincers and slashed at Hendry.

Hendry hurriedly retreated.

He narrowly dodged the steel pincers, and a pit appeared on the ground in front of him.

Faintly, Hendry could still feel the cold light coming from the steel pincers.

Hendry was terrified. He quickly picked up his machine gun and fired at the scorpion.

Green liquid splattered everywhere, and miserable screams rang out.

The scorpion kept flapping on the ground, trying to retreat.

Hendry seized the opportunity and threw out two grenades.

Boom!

Boom!

Broken limbs flew everywhere.

The entire world finally returned to silence.

Although it had only been a few minutes from the giant black scorpion’s appearance to its death, Hendry felt like a century had passed.

His entire body was covered in sweat. He sat limply on the ground and panted heavily.

At this moment, he finally understood that the Otherworld was not as easy as a spring outing.

This place… was filled with danger!

At this moment, Hendry heard an emotionless voice.

“You’re the first person to kill a level one Giant Black Scorpion. You’ve obtained a level-one treasure chest.

“You’re the first person to kill a level one Giant Black Scorpion. The Eagle Country’s land area has increased by 10%.”

As soon as the voice ended, an ancient chest appeared beside the corpse of the giant black scorpion.

Hendry panted heavily again before looking at the chest with a doubtful gaze.

After a moment of hesitation, he finally stepped forward and slowly opened it.

The chest opened, and a ray of light burst out.

A ball of light appeared in front of him.

Hendry heard the emotionless voice again.

“Ten points of Constitution. Do you want to use them?”

Hendry stammered, “Use… them.”

The next moment, the ball of light entered Hendry’s body.

Hendry felt his body squirm.

Soon, he looked at his hands in disbelief and cried out in surprise, “Unbelievable, this is too unbelievable!

“Audience, you might not believe it, but when that ball of light entered my body, all the fatigue in my body disappeared.

“At the same time, I feel that I have endless strength!

“My body is filled with power!”

As he spoke, he looked around, as if he was looking for something to prove himself.

Soon, his gaze fell on a rock the length of an arm not far away. He moved it with force, and the rock flew up.

Then, Hendry threw the stone to the side and jumped up from the ground. He was actually jumped two meters away from the ground!

…

Eagle Country’s live broadcast room.

Voss: [He jumped two meters on the spot! Oh my god! This is simply Superman!]

WHAT: [If Hendry returns to Earth and plays in the NBA in the future, he’ll be the new basketball god!]

Nilton: [Why wasn’t I chosen? I want to be Superman too!]

Moss: [Oh, God! Just now, a golden light suddenly shot out from the Void Gate, causing the seawater to drop significantly! Then, at a speed visible to the naked eye, lush green grass and trees grew. It’s simply a miracle!]

Make: [The seawater receded, and our land area directly increased by 10%!]

Duck: [It’s true, everything is true! Hendry is the true hero of our Eagle Country!]

…

On the other hand…

Hua Nation’s live broadcast was very stable and quiet, as if it was still.

Lin Fan was still sitting on the spot, not moving at all.

The bullet comments in the live broadcast room were like a heavy downpour, covering the entire live broadcast room.

Man In the Wind: [Did any of you go to the internet and watch the video of Hendry killing the Giant Black Scorpion? It was simply too shocking!]

Model: [Yeah! Furthermore, Hendry obtained ten Constitution points and became Superman. In addition, Eagle Country has increased its territory by 10%!]

3,2,1, Wooden Man: [Eagle Country might not be affected by this apocalyptic event. On the contrary, it might even grow substantially!]

Red: [I’m so envious!]

Moon Decease: [Professor Lin, quickly stand up and go fight the monsters!]

Autumn Falling Leaves: [Stop shouting. Professor Lin might really have given up on himself like what Ai Jin said. Sigh, why is Hua Nation so unlucky?]

Sister In the Sky: [In the past, I thought that Hua Nation was lucky to have Professor Lin, who gave us a chance to stand at the top of the world. Now, I realized that I was wrong, very wrong! Professor Lin succeeded greatly and is now failing greatly!]

Rumble: [Can’t we let Professor Lin see what we’re saying? We have to make Professor Lin work hard to fight monsters.]

…

In fact, it was not just the netizens who were extremely anxious.

The people in the meeting room in Jingbei were the same.

“This is really bad.”

“Professor Lin seems to have suffered a huge blow.”

“Eagle Country has already verified the authenticity of the doomsday declaration. Moreover, the performance of the heroes is calculated based on their strength. What should we do?”

“Sigh…”

…

At this moment, the man sitting at the top said, “I believe in Professor Lin!”

Everyone’s figures turned solemn as they nodded vigorously.

Then, they focused on the live broadcast again.

…

Some were worried, some were terrified…

However, there was also a group of people who were happy when they saw the live broadcast.

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hu Tian, Han Tian, Qin Yuxuan, and the others just needed to quietly look at Lin Fan and see that he was safe and sound.
